text: {"score":3,"justification":"Core numbers match the card (25.8%, 8.1%, 9.35, 3.52, 30 documented, 7 documented 99215, 0% below billed). The cautious, inconclusive stance is appropriate and it flags missing audit trail and thin documentation. But there are accuracy and grounding problems: the headline and rationale say the 99215 share runs above the all-provider share 'in every complexity band', which the card does not support (the 0-condition band has 0.0 vs 0.015). The rationale also cites claim IDs and note signals (late notes C0095109, C0096482; C0095714; 'repeated visit times') that are not on the card and can't be verified. The claim that 'heavy 99214 concentration adds to concern' is unsupported by any comparison. C0094968 and C0096409 are low-complexity 99215 claims, so they fit, but calling them 'sampled' is odd. The 'late 10%' and 'data 3%' figures are not on the card.
